chapter: Early band, Emmett Hardy and Werlein's
title: The homemade Edison record, Emmett Hardy, Bix and Whiteman
summary: Brownlee describes the home recording with Hardy, Marcour, Eastwood and Crumby, Hardy's wow-wow cornet and influence on Bix, then Walter Holzhaus joining Whiteman and Snoozer Quinn.
